verdict.rationale: Brex documents that policy rules and approvers are applied to every transaction (brex-docs-8), and booking objects expose which policy rules were violated (brex-docs-6). It also claims AI review and approval happen 'with total transparency' (brex-docs-41), which glancingly suggests policy-check and approval records exist. However, no evidence shows a per-expense audit log of edits and approvals, or an exportable or immutable trail suitable for external auditors; the audit agent (brex-docs-15) is violation monitoring, not a record trail. Missing for 10: documented per-expense edit history, approval history log, immutable or exportable audit trail, and independent confirmation that it holds up in external audits.
